<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/storefront.ts -->
<!--
  The hero of a store: a badge, the heading, a lead, one or two actions and three store promises. The overlay
  layout puts a picture beside the text with an offer card floating on it; the backdrop layout puts the text
  over a faint picture. Axes: layout (overlay, backdrop), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { OfferCard } from "./store-hero.types";
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

export type StoreHeroProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  actions: LinkActions;
  perks: Feature[];
  card: OfferCard;
  layout?: "overlay" | "backdrop";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.vue";
import Backdrop from "../components/backdrop.vue";
import OfferMedia from "../components/offer-media.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  level = 1,
  actions,
  perks,
  card,
  layout = "overlay",
  mediaSide = "end",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<StoreHeroProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Backdrop v-if="((layout as string) === 'backdrop')" kind="image" :alt="title">
    <SectionFrame
      :id="id"
      :title="title"
      :lead="lead"
      :heading="{ badge, level }"
      :tone="tone"
      density="roomy"
      measure="3xl"
    >
      <ActionGroup
        :primary="actions.cta"
        :primaryHref="actions.href"
        :secondary="((actions.mode === 'two') ? actions.secondary : undefined)"
        :secondaryHref="actions.secondaryHref"
        align="start"
      />
      <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-testid="perks">
        <template v-for="(p, i) in perks" :key="p.id">
          <Group v-if="(i < 3)" gap="4" align="start" data-testid="perk">
            <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
              <LucideIcon :name="p.icon" :size="20" />
            </Box>
            <Stack gap="0">
              <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                {{ p.title }}
              </Text>
              <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {{ p.text }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Group>
        </template>
      </Grid>
    </SectionFrame>
  </Backdrop>
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge, level }"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
    :tone="tone"
    density="default"
  >
    <ActionGroup
      :primary="actions.cta"
      :primaryHref="actions.href"
      :secondary="((actions.mode === 'two') ? actions.secondary : undefined)"
      :secondaryHref="actions.secondaryHref"
      align="start"
    />
    <Grid cols="1-3" class="gap-4" data-testid="perks">
      <template v-for="(p, i) in perks" :key="p.id">
        <Group v-if="(i < 3)" gap="4" align="start" data-testid="perk">
          <Box class="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded bg-muted">
            <LucideIcon :name="p.icon" :size="20" />
          </Box>
          <Stack gap="0">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {{ p.title }}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ p.text }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
        </Group>
      </template>
    </Grid>
    <template #aside>
      <OfferMedia :alt="title" :card="card" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
